---
title: "Blog"
subtitle: "Notes on things I'm working through — usually half-finished, occasionally useful."
toc: false
format:
  html:
    css:
      - ../styles.css
      - ../blog.css
      - ../listings.css
listing:
  contents: posts
  type: default
  sort: "date desc"
  categories: unnumbered
  feed:
    items: 20
    type: full
  # `kind` is a custom front-matter field ("Essay", "Interactive essay", …).
  fields: [image, kind, date, title, description, categories]
  field-display-names:
    kind: "Type"
  sort-ui: [date, title]
  filter-ui: true
  page-size: 12
  image-align: right
  image-height: 140px
  date-format: "MMM D, YYYY"
  max-description-length: 180
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: false
---
